question: When the LORD sent Gideon to save Israel, what reason did Gideon give for why he could not do it?
options: He was too old to fight
His clan was the weakest in Manasseh and he was the least in his family
explanation: Gideon said his clan was the weakest in Manasseh and he was the least in his family. The LORD answered, "I will be with you."
